inference.regression: entity post-minus-pre changes on intercept and treated indicator; cluster CR1 with N=entities,K=2; Student t with cluster_count-1 df; DDD uses intercept,T,S,T*S with K=4
inference.staggered: unconditional group-time mean changes with entity influence functions aggregated by assignment cluster

monte_carlo_metrics: bias relative to assigned treatment effect
pass_gates: Only deterministic arithmetic, artifact integrity, finite JSON, schema and replay comparisons are pass gates. Monte Carlo rejection or coverage rates have no statistical pass threshold.
scope: Synthetic validation of the actual did-analysis Skill. No empirical causal claim, conditional covariate-adjusted ATT, doubly robust estimator, multiplier bootstrap, or exact full Callaway-Sant'Anna replication is claimed.
